title: success-criterion verify_command timeout is hardcoded 300s; the full suite now runs 240-320s
detail: gate.py:2401 _VERIFY_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SEC=300, not configurable per criterion. cost-budget sprint-complete failed cost-budget-full-suite with exit=-2 (timeout) though the suite was green 3x the same day (238s, 317s). Every full-suite criterion is now a coin-flip on machine load. Needs a validated per-criterion timeout_sec (or one derived from the suite's measured duration), and a timeout must be reported as an instrument limit, distinct from a failing suite.

resolution.verify: uv run python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_review_round_integrity.py
